275: class OwnedWin32Primitives:
276:     """Concrete handle/process mechanics; no complete acquire_read capability.
277: 
278:     A trusted single-threaded bootstrap owns this object. HandleRecord and
279:     WorkerRecord instances are also tracked by identity; external lookalikes
280:     do not authorize operations. Recovery after process death is not supplied.
281:     """
282: 
283:     def __init__(self, api):
284:         self.api = api
285:         self.handles = []
286:         self.workers = []
287:         self.read_sets = []
288: 
289:     def _retain(self, value, kind):
290:         invalid = self.api.ffi.c_void_p(-1).value
291:         if value is None or value == 0 or value == invalid:
292:             raise OSError(self.api.ffi.get_last_error(), kind + " returned an invalid handle")
293:         record = HandleRecord(value, kind)
294:         self.handles.append(record)
295:         return record
296: 
297:     def _owned(self, handle):
298:         if not any(item is handle for item in self.handles) or handle.closed or handle.unconfirmed:
299:             raise KernelUnconfirmed("Handle ownership is not confirmed")
300:         return handle.value
301: 
302:     def _close(self, handle):
303:         value = self._owned(handle)
304:         try:
305:             self.api.checked("CloseHandle", value)
306:         except BaseException:
307:             handle.unconfirmed = True
308:             raise
309:         handle.closed = True
310: 
311:     def _query(self, handle, kind, class_id):
312:         data = self.api.structure(kind)
313:         self.api.checked("GetFileInformationByHandleEx", self._owned(handle), class_id,
314:                          self.api.ffi.byref(data), self.api.ffi.sizeof(data))
315:         return data
316: 
317:     def identity(self, handle):
318:         ffi = self.api.ffi
319:         tags = self._query(handle, "FILE_ATTRIBUTE_TAG_INFO", FILE_ATTRIBUTE_TAG_INFO_CLASS)
320:         standard = self._query(handle, "FILE_STANDARD_INFO", FILE_STANDARD_INFO_CLASS)
321:         identity = self._query(handle, "FILE_ID_INFO", FILE_ID_INFO_CLASS)
322:         if tags.attributes & FILE_ATTRIBUTE_REPARSE_POINT or tags.reparse_tag or standard.delete_pending or standard.size < 0:
323:             raise KernelUnavailable("Reparse, pending deletion or invalid size refused")
324:         buffer = ffi.create_unicode_buffer(32768)
325:         length = self.api.call("GetFinalPathNameByHandleW", self._owned(handle), buffer, len(buffer), 0)
326:         if not 0 < length < len(buffer):
327:             raise KernelUnavailable("Final handle path is unavailable or oversized")
328:         return FileIdentity(buffer.value, int(identity.volume), bytes(identity.file_id), int(standard.size),
329:                             int(standard.links), bool(standard.directory))
